messages:
carmen: Starlight flagged a sudden embed bill spike in the promo window (2025-11-03 02:00-06:00 UTC). Can billing-eng look?
nikhil: Quick look at raw exports shows two ingestion paths for the same customer during that window: embed-ingest + edge-proxy. Possible replay duplication.
tara (billing-eng): We rolled a replay patch at ~02:15 that reprocessed queued batches. Logs show replayer=true on many records. Dedupe may have missed those.
billing-bot: export summary: rows=4,823; embed_tokens=4,912,311; distinct_request_ids=4,799; suspect_dupes=24
carmen: 24 marked dupes doesn't account for ~12% invoice delta. Could proration be compounding this?
nikhil: Yes. Promo credits are computed per-hour. If a request is counted before promo bucket cutover then reprocessed into promo bucket, you briefly see full charge + later credit, which inflates draft invoice during reconciliation.
tara (billing-eng): I'll open a backfill to recompute per-hour promo credits and run stricter dedupe. Ticket BLG-4521, ETA ~6h.
james (finance-head): Approve provisional credit for clearly duplicated tokens to placate customer. Recommend holding final invoice until BLG-4521 completes.
nikhil: Estimate dup tokens ~180k -> provisional credit ~= $360 (rate used: $0.002/embed-token equiv).
carmen: I'll tell the customer we're applying a credit and will follow up after the backfill.
tara (billing-eng): Adding a small replayer safeguard to attach dedupe-token on reprocess to avoid cross-hour recounts. BLG-4521 queued.
billing-bot: BLG-4521 created by tara. status=queued
james (finance-head): Good. Keep updates here if the backfill finds more systemic gaps.
